rationale: The Summer '26 API v67 Apex user-mode change creates an immediate, time-bounded security risk for every Salesforce org running custom Apex triggers. Enterprise buyers already pay consultants for exactly this kind of breaking-change audit, and the Salesforce Stack Exchange signal shows real developer confusion about production security implications. Willingness-to-pay is supported by the established market for Salesforce security audits at $99–299/engagement.
